column2: Nightmare haunting\nwomen's dreams.\nDrains vigor, maybe life

Ox-headed warden of
hell. Hot-tempered, he
rages after taking
enough damage.

Horse-headed warden of
hell. Hot-tempered, he
rages after taking
enough damage.

Skeleton warrior that
wanders the underworld
seeking a body. Throws
bones with effects.
Evil spirit born of\nhuman malice. Foul\nbreath binds foes.

Gilbert's own machine
built by the Society.
Proudly shows off its
many weapons.
Angel statue guarding\nthe sanctuary. Freezes\nintruders with a glare.

Large monster who loves
seeing people tremble.
Hard scales, poison
claws. May call allies.

Gate of heaven that
sees sins. Judges good
and evil and brings
retribution.
Single - Attack\nSwirling crimson flames scorch the foe.

Ancient mollusk adapted
to lava. Great at fire
arts and regrows when
hurt.

Herald of heaven that
announces the end of
an age. Calls allies
and blows up when dying.

Valkyrie guarding the
heavens. Keeps distance
and hinders with a bow.
Second of three.

Valkyrie guarding the
heavens. Casts strong
arts, slaps hard.
Youngest of three.
Evil forest fairy.\nScratches doggedly with\npoison claws.

Demon living deep in
the mountains. Always
meditates to cut worldly
desire.

Evil worm born from
Rostrum's flesh.
Carries toxins and
healing fluid.

Ries aiming her Gale
Sword at allies. These
are surely her own
techniques...

Kevin aiming his
crossbow at allies.
The sharpness is
certainly his own...
Huge evil worm that\nfeeds on lava. Causes\nlocal quakes when hurt.

Prototype doll weapon
made by the Society.
Uses odd attacks that
hinder foes.

Prototype doll weapon
made by the Society.
When cornered, unleashes
huge firepower.

Wind demon seeking
freedom. Strong blows and
poison breath corner
foes.
Spider-shaped nightmare\nwith various poison\nfangs. Also quick.

Horse-shaped nightmare.
Breaks minds and
freezes foes with
icy breath.

Human turned mostly
wolf by black magic.
Plays with prey using
poison claws and rushes.

Anelace?, sword in hand,
blocks her allies.
Slices with sharp,
graceful swordplay.

Scherazard? with whip
in hand. Switches
between whip and arts
to hurt mind and body.

Guardian of the Ring
born from the Shadow
Lord. Unleashes a special
attack after big damage.

Ancient centaur-type
giant doll weapon.
Swings its sword wildly
and drops thunder.

Society strategic
weapon born from the
Shadow Lord. Destroys
until foes are gone.

Crimson ancient dragon
born from the Shadow
Lord. Tough body, uses
ancient magic.

Agate? blocks allies
and attacks. Swings a
heavy sword with ease,
strong moves.
River-dwelling mollusk\nmonster. Sprays sticky\nsnot to stop prey.
Human given a bat body\nby black magic. Strong\ncurses transform prey.
Jet-black armor soldier\ngiven life. Something\nhappens if slain?

Weapon moved by
Philip's psychic waves.
Shocks and paralyzes
foes.

Society patrol doll
weapon. Heavy armor,
calls reinforcements
when hurt.

Ghost of Kevin's
mother. Curses all it
sees and drains their
abilities.

Tuned Grimoire. Uses
a forbidden art to exile
foes and blows up when
dying.

Young dragon like the
ancient dragon Regnat.
Uses 3 breaths and
tackles.

Guardian of the Moon
Gate. Heals whoever
attacks it. But when
weak...

Guardian of the Star
Gate. Heals whoever
attacks it. But when
weak...

Society base-defense
Over Marionette. When
cornered, unleashes
huge firepower.
Amorphous monster.\nCan mimic what it\nhas observed.

Jet-black dragon doll
weapon made by the
Society from ancient
tech. Absurd firepower.
Black-suited fighter.\nCorners foes with\nvarious special rounds.

Dead soul fallen to
Purgatory. Drains life,
splits repeatedly,
explodes when it dies.

Powerful demon who
guards Purgatory. Slays
foes with unmatched
strength.

Orbal tank secretly
developed by the old
Intel Dept. Upgraded
for more firepower.

Scherazard's client.
Swings an iron-lined bag
and boldly joins in
the fight.

Aina's uncle and the
black suits' employer.
Unarmed, but looks after
himself and backs up.
R&A Research president.\nCuts foes in two with\nblinding iaido.

Erebonian Imperial Army
major with master swords.
Uses aura crafts to
pull foes in.

Prototype ride weapon
by Central Workshop.
Seat is small, so only
kids can ride it.

Prototype ride weapon
by Central Workshop.
In a rampage and
uncontrollable.
Attack S-Craft: Single\nHeavy sword combo with even sharper technique.

Skilled full bracer
known as Heavy Sword.
Attacks fiercely with
dragon-aura slashes.
